prose.description: A horned, bony people whose plates cover them from head to toe like natural armor. They are few in number, strong, tough, and prone to violence. Their culture prizes pride, honor, and strength, and many would rather die in a hopeless battle than live in disgrace. Horns are a source of pride, and a Shek judged a coward may have them cut off. They revere Kral, a legendary warrior said to have fought against impossible odds and to have entered the afterlife called the Gateway.
prose.speech: Stoic, with little humor, until a battle is at hand.
